Name: Triumph Sports Trio Toss
Natural: Get the 3 hottest tailgate games in 1 fantastic setBag Toss, Washer Toss, and Ladder TossDurable wood game boards and PVC laddersIncludes 8 bean bags, 6 washers, and 6 bolasSeparate carry handle on each game boardPieces combine and fit in included carry caseBoards measure 28L x 18.5W x 2H inchesGames designed for 2-8 players. The Triumph Sports Trio Toss is the trifecta of outdoor games - it combines the three hottest backyard games on the market into one portable unit! Take the Trio Toss anywhere, and enjoy the fun, friendly competition of Bag Toss, Washer Toss, and Ladder Toss games. The two wood plank game boards can be used for all three games, and the sturdy PVC ladders are meant for Ladder Toss.The set includes eight bean bags, six washers, and six bolas in red and blue. Each game board features a handle on the side for easy setup. These boards combine and fit easily into a handy carry case with shoulder strap for efficient storage and transport. Boards measure 28L x 18.5W x 2H inches.Game RulesEach team starts with four bean bags. Simply alternate throws on each turn. Any bag that goes through the hole is worth three points. Any bag that stays on the board is worth one point. Yes, you can knock off your opponent's bags. But be careful - you can also knock them through the hole! Just subtract the low score from the high score at the end of each round.For example: If Team A has one bag in the hole and two bags on the board, their score would be five points. If Team B has two bags on the board, their score would be two points. Team A (five points) - Team B (two points) = Team A (three points). Team A would receive three points for that turn. Determine a finishing point total and let the fun begin! Color: blue/red.
